field.name: Client
field.summary: HTTP client used for Catalog requests.

field.name: Endpoint
field.summary: Absolute service endpoint used to construct request URIs.

field.name: HttpClientOwned
field.summary: Indicates whether this client is responsible for disposing its HttpClient.

field.name: DefaultToken
field.summary: Default authorization token used when a request does not provide a token.

method.name: SendAsync
method.summary: Send an HTTP request and return a catalog-specific response containing its status, raw content, and optional deserialized response data. For paged Catalog searches, reuse the same filters and pass each response's NextCatalogPageToken as the next request's CatalogPageToken.

method.name: ResolveToken
method.summary: Resolve the authorization token to use for a request, falling back to the constructor token when no request token is supplied.

method.name: CreateRequestUri
method.summary: Create an absolute request URI by resolving a Catalog route path against the configured endpoint. Root-relative paths target the service origin's root path.
method.param: Absolute or relative Catalog route path.
